product_summary: Loan facility to spruce up and renovate existing homes including tiling, flooring, internal/external plaster and painting. Available for both existing and new customers at home loan interest rates.

pricing.other_charges_notes: Fixed Rate Loans: 2% prepayment charges plus applicable taxes except for own sources. Variable Rate Loans: Nil prepayment charges. Processing fee non-refundable. Senior citizens eligible for 10% discount on service charges.

collateral_accepted: Security interest on property being financed
documents_required: Identity Proof (Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/NREGA card/NPR letter/Aadhaar)
Balance Sheet and P&L statements (last 2 years for self-employed)
Bank statements showing loan repayment history
key_features: Interest rates same as home loans
24x7 customer assistance via chat and WhatsApp
Available for both existing and new customers
Tax benefits on principal under Income Tax Act 1961
Can fund immovable furniture and fixtures
Disbursement in installments based on renovation progress
fees_table_raw: Processing Fee: 0.50%-1.50% of loan amount or Rs. 4,000-5,000 minimum (varies by category), non-refundable. Re-appraisal after 6 months: Rs. 3,300-5,000. Conversion fee (floating to fixed): Rs. 3,000. Document copies: Rs. 500. Repayment mode change: Rs. 500. Prepayment (Fixed Rate): 2% of amount prepaid plus taxes. Prepayment (Variable Rate): Nil. Property document retention: Rs. 1,000/month after 60 days from closure. Payment return charges: Rs. 450. Administrative charges: Rs. 5,000 plus taxes.
